paragraphs: R' Yudan son of R' Chama of Kefar Tehumin.
He is mentioned in Taanit chapter 1, halakha 7, where he said in the name of Chizkiya, and in Ketubot chapter 2, halakha 9, the reading is "of Kefar HaChamin."[^1][^2]

notes.text: פ״א ה״ז/פ״ב ה״ט give 1h 7/2h 9, without naming the Talmud corpus; Jerusalem Talmud is contextual inference only, no new verification.

Tehumin and HaChamin preserve the two place forms, not an identified modern location or harmonized reading. The headed Yudan reports in the name of untitled Chizkiya. Both abbreviated heading titles, including the father’s, remain R'.
